title: CareerLens MCP Connector Admission Contract v1
rules: A connector is an admission record only: it declares namespace, allowed tools, required scope and the exact config digest that was reviewed.
Connectors are disabled by default; enabling is an explicit user action and does not execute any tool or open any network connection.
config_digest is computed over the exact declared config; any config change requires re-review and a new digest, so a reviewed config cannot silently change.
Admission is default deny: a tool is allowed only if its fully qualified name starts with the connector namespace, is in allowed_tools, and the caller has required_scope; explicit deny wins.
Model-supplied user_id, workspace_id or scope are never accepted as an authority; identity comes from the trusted invocation context.
An MCP connector never receives career-library manage scope automatically; it is read-scoped unless a user explicitly grants a higher scope.
No external MCP client, no outbound network call and no third-party code is loaded into the daemon or the agent CLI by this contract.
Isolated execution and network policy require an OS sandbox and remain unverified; this contract governs admission only.
